historical_reviews.deepseek: Misidentifies a GPU container workload as generic CPU HPL and loses four data configurations.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: Restores pinned container, MPI/GPU mapping, HPL residual/performance evidence and privilege gates.
historical_reviews.related_cases: HPCG uses a different sparse workload and data/mount contract; it cannot supply HPL performance or residual evidence.
historical_reviews.v3_1: Requires an NVIDIA/DGX-compatible oracle rather than silently comparing GPU HPL to an undefined Intel/AMD spec.

original_test_intent: Run NVIDIA HPL in 1-, 2-, 4- and 8-process configurations using the corresponding DGX data files, validate numerical residuals, and assess scale/performance against an approved architecture-matched reference.
original_method: Pin container digest and HPL scripts/data hashes; validate Docker/NVIDIA/driver/CUDA/MPI/UCX and privileges; map ranks to GPU UUID/BDF; inspect resource/memory/shm needs; resolve reference; preserve baseline and isolate jobs; execute four tracked containers sequentially with telemetry/timeout; retain full HPL residual/performance/exit; stop containers and compare platform health.
manual_activity: HPC owner pins image/data, maps ranks/GPUs and selects a valid reference; operator approves root-capable container workload and recovery; agent may run the four approved cases.
required_inputs: Container image digest and hpl.sh plus four HPL data-file hashes
Docker/NVIDIA runtime, driver/CUDA/MPI/UCX compatibility and privilege policy
GPU UUID/BDF and -np rank mapping for 1/2/4/8
Validated shared-memory, memlock, network/transport and memory budget
SUT isolation, telemetry/timeout and container/GPU recovery approval
safety_requirements: Never pull floating image or run root-enabled container without approval
Verify each data file matches NP and target resource capacity
Do not infer GPU mapping from rank count
Abort on residual failure, MPI hang, XID, thermal/power or host impact
Stop all containers/process trees; no GPU reset or runtime change as improvised cleanup
agent_execution_scope: Run four exact NP/data configurations sequentially
Report per-run comparison without DUT verdict
engineer_actions: Resolve Intel/AMD criterion and approve NVIDIA oracle

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: MKL/ACML generic HPL is not the source NVIDIA HPC container and omits four DGX data files and MPI mappings.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Run the digest-pinned NVIDIA image with the exact four source MPI/data combinations under approved privileges, capturing HPL residual, GFLOPS, mapping and exit for each.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Image tag, -np 1/2/4/8, all HPL-dgx data files, UCX/Open MPI flags and 60-minute estimates are preserved pending digest/reference approval.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Use a four-row scale-up manifest tying NP, data hash, rank/GPU map, residual, GFLOPS and efficiency to container digest and telemetry.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds numerical validity and a defensible GPU reference instead of an undefined CPU-spec comparison.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: CPU MKL/ACML HPL cannot substitute for GPU HPL container/runtime and DGX data coverage.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Root MPI and Docker expand host impact; HPL can saturate GPU/CPU/memory/power and may hang across transport misconfiguration.

project_override_considerations: Performance owner selects the NVIDIA/DGX reference, residual rule and scale efficiency expectations for each NP/data case.
expected_evidence: Image digest and HPL script/data hashes
GPU UUID/BDF and per-NP rank mapping
Four exact commands, full outputs/exits, residual and GFLOPS/scaling
Approved reference revision and per-NP comparison
GPU/CPU/memory/temperature/power plus dmesg/XID/PCIe/BMC/SEL deltas, cleanup and verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Procedure is explicitly NVIDIA GPU HPL in an NGC container, while Criteria only says match Intel/AMD spec and provides no transferable metric or threshold.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Static review is complete; execution/result disposition awaits the architecture oracle and ordinary runtime inputs.

engineering_decision_pending.question: Resolve Compatibility row280 Wistron-NV GPU-00273-V004: replace or map the undefined Intel/AMD spec criterion to an approved NVIDIA/DGX HPL oracle for NP 1/2/4/8, including GFLOPS, residual, scaling efficiency, units/tolerances, image digest/data hashes, and rank-to-GPU mapping.

review_improvement: Preserves all four NVIDIA container runs and separates numerical validity, performance and scale-up from an invalid architecture comparison.
independent_technical_reasoning: HPL performance depends on accelerator kernels, problem data, MPI rank placement and runtime transports; CPU Intel/AMD figures are not directly comparable to the NVIDIA container. Each NP case also needs numerical residual acceptance before performance is meaningful. Image tag alone is mutable, and root-capable Docker/MPI creates host-level risk that must be explicitly bounded.
